verdict.rationale: HelixDB's first-party docs describe vector indexes that rank node or edge embeddings by distance, where every index definition requires a dimension and a distance metric. Its llms.txt describes the engine as offering approximate vector search, and prefiltering before vector ranking is also documented. missing for 10: an enumeration of the supported distance metrics, details of the ANN index algorithm or tuning parameters, and independent or hands-on corroboration of search quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run approximate nearest-neighbor similarity search over embeddings with configurable distance metrics

citations.quote: Vector indexes rank node or edge embeddings by distance. Every definition requires a non-zero dimension and a distance metric.
HelixDB combines a property graph, approximate vector search, and BM25 full-text search
traverse and filter an exact candidate set before vector ranking
